Equality in the Rayleigh principle forces the leaf and hub-star edge weights. The exact three-dimensional quotient Laplacian has eigenvalues 0,(n+1)/(5n−4),3(2n−1)/(5n−4), while remaining eigenvalues are 1−p−λ_j(L_W). Independent symbolic factorization checked the quotient and forced edge mass; these spectral identities establish necessity and sufficiency of the internal spectral window, including nonnegative diagonal rows. The uniform internal point attains the lower bound.
